jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.description:
Advertisement Template English

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Production team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Marketing Director  100%

Shanghai ,China

Your contribution

Objective

Short term - As an integral part of the sales & marketing team to drive achievement of company targets

Long-term - To develop robust strategic & operational marketing plans to support company

Development and implementation of an effective China business development plan and marketing strategy in close coordination with the global product & strategic marketing and business units

Work with sales leaders to develop and implement business process improvement and operation plan / actions and to develop and execute clear and consistent marketing strategies for products in different market segments / applications

Effectively manage a marketing team consisting of application specialists / managers and Marcom Manager to formulate and drive relevant sales support activities e.g. product demonstrations, presentations, trade shows, product trainings, etc. in daily basis ·

Responsibilities

• Definition of market and sales / pricing strategies by customer segments, products and applications in collabo-ration with Global Business Units and local sales leaders to define relevant product and market strategies

• Be an important channel to regularly communicate with Global Product & Business teams on local market trends and market needs

• Work with sales leaders to develop field sales actions plan for various market segments

• Actively involve in the annual budget planning process and mid range strategic planning

• Oversee the development and production of marketing communications materials and tools e.g. brochures, advertisements, company website and trade events, etc.

• Daily management of the applications team to deliver effective sales support activities in the market

• Work with sales leaders on the development of KOL programs and retention of KOLs

• Regular report to the company on sales trend / price analysis and recommend actions for improvement

• Regular update to the company on market competition development

• Set up "new product launch" process and develop effective product launch plan to support new product launches

• Be responsible for the business performance of key products in the market. Possessing indepth knowledge about the life science research and diagnostic market segments

• Formulation and execution of marketing strategies for key products in the market

• Control and efficient use of company resources to support the achievement of sales and operational targets

• Provide coaching and supervisions for the team and develop appropriate development programs for key talents

• Drives the adoption of value-based selling across teams, ensuring alignment on customer value, and coaching managers and employees to deliver differentiated solutions.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Master in Life Science subjects with equivalent 7-10 years of relevant experience

• Excellent leadership and communication skills

• Pre-launch product development skills

• Project management skills

• Fluent in both verbal and written English

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology # etc.

(add individual hashtags – related to job, education, skills)

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.title: Production Engineer
jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unserer Production Team und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

Production Engineer (100%)

Männedorf, Schweiz

Dein Beitrag

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle tragen Sie die technische Verantwortung für ein Produkteportfolio während dem Lifecycle-Management. Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis und Leidenschaft für komplexe Systeme sowie dem Drang nach steter Verbesserung tragen Sie massgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Produkte stets höchsten Kundenansprüchen genügen. Sie stehen als Schnittstelle im Zentrum zwischen der internen/externen Produktion, Forschung & Entwicklung, Beschaffung, Produkt-Management und Qualitätssicherung.

• Definition und Entwicklung der MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Prozesse

• End-to-End Implementierung und kontinuierliche Optimierung des MES

• Verantwortung für Projekt- und Teilprojektmanagement bei komplexen MES-Implementierungen und Rollouts

• Technische Betreuung der zugeteilten Produkte von der Freigabe der Nullserie bis zum Phase-out.

• Initiierung und Umsetzung von mechanischen, elektronischen oder Softwareänderungen zusammen mit einem Team von Fachexperten.

• Fehleranalyse und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Planung und Leitung von Prozess Validierungen in unserer Produktion oder bei Lieferanten.

• Entwicklung und Planung der benötigten Produktions- und Prüfmittel

• Prozessbetreuung und -steuerung der zugewiesenen Produktionslinien durch Überwachung der Kennzahlen

• Sicherstellen der Datenqualität im ERP System für eine reibungslose Auftragsabwicklung

• Mitarbeit in LCM-Projekten, um die produktionstechnischen Aspekte einzubringen

• Unterstützung der Qualitätssicherung in technischen Fragen

• Unterstützung des Einkaufs bei technischen Fragen und Aktivitäten mit Lieferanten und Sub-Lieferanten

Dein Profil

• Motivation und Eigenverantwortung, um unsere Produkte und Produktionsprozesse stetig zu verbessern.

• Ingenieur Studium (Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Systemtechnik oder Produktionstechnik) oder Techniker/-in HF Elektrotechnik oder Maschinenbau mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Nebst fachlicher Expertise sind wir auch auf der Suche nach einer Persönlichkeit, welche durch proaktives Handeln und dem Drang nach stetiger Verbesserung hervorsticht.

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

·         Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

·         Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

·         Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

·         Starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur

·         Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work!  Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren.  Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, welche unsere Anforderungen erfüllen.

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vi siete mai chiesti come le vostre abilità e background unico possono influenzare il mondo di domani? Entrate a far parte del nostro team di produzione e usate il talento e la passione che vi contraddistinguono. Ingegnere di Produzione (100%) Männedorf, Svizzera Il tuo contributo In questo ruolo versatile, si assume la responsabilità tecnica di un portafoglio di prodotti durante la gestione del ciclo di vita. Con la vostra comprensione tecnica e la passione per i sistemi complessi e la spinta al miglioramento costante, contribuite in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino sempre i più elevati requisiti del cliente. Essi servono come interfaccia tra produzione interna / esterna, ricerca e sviluppo, approvvigionamento, gestione del prodotto e garanzia di qualità.
• Definizione e sviluppo dei processi MES (Manufacturing Execution System)
• Esecuzione end-to-end e ottimizzazione continua del MES
• Responsabilità per la gestione di progetti e sottoprogetti in complesse implementazioni e rollout MES
• Supporto tecnico dei prodotti assegnati dal rilascio della serie zero al phase-out.
• Iniziazione e implementazione di cambiamenti meccanici, elettronici o software insieme a un team di specialisti.
• Analisi degli errori e implementazione di misure di miglioramento
• Pianificazione e gestione delle validazioni di processo nella nostra produzione o presso i fornitori.
• Sostegno e controllo delle linee di produzione assegnate mediante il monitoraggio dei dati chiave
• Garantire la qualità dei dati nel sistema ERP per un trattamento regolare degli ordini
• Collaborazione nei progetti LCM al fine di incorporare gli aspetti produttivi
• Supporto per l'assicurazione della qualità in materia tecnica
• Supporto per l'acquisto in materia tecnica e attività con fornitori e subfornitori Il tuo profilo
• Motivazione e responsabilità personale per migliorare continuamente i nostri prodotti e processi produttivi.
• Studi di ingegneria (ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria di sistema o ingegneria di produzione) o tecnico in ingegneria elettrica HF o ingegneria meccanica con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale
• Ottima conoscenza della tecnologia di produzione, progettazione e logistica
• Esperienza professionale nella tecnologia medica regolamentata / biofarmaco, automazione, industria automobilistica e/o aviazione
• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco e inglese in parole e scrittura
• Oltre alle competenze tecniche, stiamo anche cercando una personalità che si distingue per l'azione proattiva e la voglia di un costante miglioramento. Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico? · L'opportunità di fare la differenza e modellare il mondo di domani · Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato · Eccitanti opportunità di carriera · Forte e unica cultura aziendale · Compensazioni e vantaggi interessanti Diventare parte di Tecan, certificata come Grande Luogo di lavoro! Qui potete scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione. Ottimo posto per lavorare. Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi). Possiamo solo considerare le applicazioni che soddisfano le nostre esigenze. Il nostro scopo. A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi. Rimanete unici e fatelo contare. I nostri valori - fiducia, elevati standard e ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro. Ente giuridico:

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?

Tecan is a pioneer and a globally leading company in laboratory automation and a healthcare enabler. The company is improving people’s lives and health by empowering customers to scale healthcare innovation globally. Tecan enables customers to scale their innovation, whether in laboratory workflows for life science research, various applied markets and diagnostics or in product development and manufacturing for the medical market. Tecan delivers this broad range of healthcare products and services directly to end users or with OEM partners.

Are you ready to drive strategic impact on a global scale? As our Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of our transformation toward value-based pricing, shaping the way we define and measure commercial success. Join our Global Commercial  Excellence team and become the champion for pricing innovation and commercial metrics—partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams to embed best practices and ensure transparency across the organization. If you’re passionate about analytics, collaboration, and making a difference, this is your opportunity to lead change and elevate our commercial performance worldwide!

Manager Strategic Pricing & Analytics 100%

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution
 Join our Global Commercial Excellence team as a Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager! In this pivotal role you will:

•    Drive with the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of value-based pricing approaches across products, markets, and customer segments.
 •    Support new product development and launches with pricing analyses, price recommendations, and business case assessments
 •    Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to define a new global pricing policy and governance
 •    Build analytical models and methodologies to support value-based price setting, price differentiation, and price positioning
 •    Define and standardize metrics, with focus on pricing, such as price realization, discount rate, deal margin, and value capture indicators
 •    Design and maintain pricing analytics dashboards, tools, and reporting that enable pricing execution and monitoring
 •    Drive and own the global annual price adjustments process and coordinate its implementation

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. The position requires the following:

Hard / Technical Skills
 •    BA / MBA preferably in STEM
 •    Min 5 years of experience in pricing management and commercial analytics
 •    Strong understanding of pricing and commercial metrics
 •    Understanding of value-based pricing principles and value capture mechanisms in B2B environments
 •    Demonstrated experience designing dashboards and reports that support pricing and commercial decisions (e.g., in PowerBI or Tableau)
 •    Ability to build and interpret pricing models, scenario analyses, and what-if simulations
 •    Proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel (advanced), SQL, Python/R, or BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
 •    Excellent level of English – any additional languages are of added value
 •    Passion for life sciences / healthcare topics

Soft Skills
 •    Ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders across all levels
 •    Strong team player with strong oral & written communication skills
 •    Proactive & takes initiative to get things done
 •    Can-do mindset
 •    Well organized and able to structure fast moving projects
 •    Takes accountability for own work and is firmly focused on results
 •    Eager to learn, explore new ideas & opportunities on a day-to-day basis

What makes working at Tecan unique
 •    You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.
 •    The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

Unitevi al nostro team di eccellenza commerciale globale e diventate il campione dell'innovazione dei prezzi e delle metriche commerciali - partnerando con le squadre di Vendita, Marketing, Finanza e Prodotti per inserire le migliori pratiche e garantire la trasparenza all'interno dell'organizzazione. Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

VP, Head System Solutions R&D (80- 100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive the strategic direction of System Solutions R&D for Tecan’s complex life sciences and medical technology portfolio. You will shape the system architecture vision, oversee multidisciplinary teams, and ensure the integrity and excellence of our products across hardware, software, applications, automation, and regulated workflows. From concept to market launch and lifecycle management, you will be the senior leader ensuring our solutions are safe, effective, and ready for the world.

Responsibilities

• Provide strategic leadership for the System Solutions R&D function, setting vision and direction for systems engineering, architecture, integration, and application science.

• Own and maintain the system architecture, strategy, and technology roadmap across the product portfolio.

• Set standards for requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration across multidisciplinary teams.

• Partner with PMO, Product Management, Marketing, and Business Leaders to shape portfolio strategy and define product roadmaps.

• Lead early-stage technical due diligence, feasibility assessments, and risk evaluations for investment decisions.

• Champion best practices in design controls, risk management, verification, and validation.

• Provide executive technical oversight for integration, system verification, and release readiness decisions.

• Build and grow technical leadership within the function, including hiring, performance management, and talent development.

• Foster strong partnerships across functions and represent System Solutions in executive reviews and governance forums.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, technical excellence, and innovation.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Master’s degree preferred.

• Advanced business education or a business degree is a nice to have.

• 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, product development, and innovation within life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices, or other highly regulated industries.

• Proven success leading system architecture and cross-functional technical execution for complex multidisciplinary products.

• Strong track record of building and leading high-performing teams in global, matrixed organizations.

• Demonstrated senior leadership experience in building and developing multidisciplinary R&D organizations.

• Skilled at coaching, mentoring, and developing technical leaders within the organization.

• Comfortable leading across geographies and cultures, promoting diversity and inclusion.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience with digital/data-driven products or AI-assisted workflows is a plus.

• Willingness to travel internationally (30%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our EHS Office team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Product Environmental Compliance Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this important and hands-on role, you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product environmental compliance at Tecan, responsible for ensuring global compliance with all relevant product environmental and sustainability regulations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will operationally execute compliance processes and lead multiple complex regulatory projects across various Tecan sites. Your expertise will help shape Tecan’s approach to regulated substances in articles, extended producer responsibility, and the implementation of effective compliance strategies, all within a dynamic environment where regulatory developments are proactively monitored and integrated into our compliance efforts.

Responsibilities

• Execute Tecan’s global SOPs for compliance with regulated substances in articles and extend producer responsibility (RoHS, REACH, POP, TSCA, Conflict Minerals, WEEE, batteries, packaging) including collection of supplier declarations and preparation of compliance documentation

• Lead and implement multiple complex regulatory projects, ensuring efficient prioritization and execution (e.g. RoHS 6b, PFAS)

• Manage the global product environmental compliance database, including compliance software and data maintenance.

• Secure compliance with local extended producer responsibility obligations (WEEE, packaging, batteries), including registrations and reporting.

• Contribute to surveillance and analysis of the global regulatory landscape, supporting the development of long-term compliance strategies.

• Support technical evaluation of new regulations, early risk identification, and design of mitigation strategies.

• Act as a subject matter expert for senior leaders and cross-functional teams, answering internal and external queries.

• Provide training on product environmental compliance topics and perform internal/intra-company audits.

• Maintain clear compliance status reporting and coordinate issuing of compliance certificates and Critical Mineral reporting.

• Possibility to represent Tecan in trade associations, ensuring alignment with industry standards.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Higher education degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; chemical background is a plus.

• 5+ years of experience in product stewardship or product environmental regulations, preferably in MedTech.

• Experience implementing complex product environmental requirements.

• Familiarity with product environmental regulations and standards (RoHS, REACH, POP, PFAS, WEEE, Batteries, Packaging).

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

• Strong communicator able to explain the “why” behind regulations to diverse audiences.

Production Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Schweiz

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle tragen Sie die technische Verantwortung für ein Produkteportfolio während dem Lifecycle-Management. Dein Profil

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in oder Mechatroniker:in, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung (z.B. Techniker:in HF oder vergleichbar)

• Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Produktion, idealerweise in der Medizintechnik, Bio-Pharma, Automatisierung, Automobil- oder Aviatikindustrie

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Product Management team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Head Software Product Management (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this pivotal leadership role within our Product Management team, you will define and drive Tecan’s software strategy for our liquid handling product portfolio. As Head of Software Product Management, you will bridge Product Management and R&D, ensuring that architectural and product decisions serve both customer needs and business objectives. You will build, develop, and lead a high-performing Software Product Management team, championing a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and accountability.

You will play a key role in transformation—leading change, developing people, and making critical decisions on hiring, team structure, and performance management. Your ability to execute, set clear direction, and deliver measurable results will be essential as you drive platform improvements and ensure our software products meet the highest standards of quality and compliance.

Responsibilities

• Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing Software Product Management team through clear direction, coaching, and succession planning.

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-accountability team culture.

• Champion customer insight and competitive awareness as the foundation for all software product decisions.

• Drive Tecan’s software strategy and product roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform health.

• Serve as the dedicated product counterpart for software architecture within R&D, ensuring business-defined requirements are met.

• Serve as the product voice in architectural decisions across all software layers, ensuring control, orchestration, middleware, applications, and integrations align with business-defined requirements

• Lead build vs. buy vs. partner evaluations for software components and platform capabilities.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• A degree in Software/Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an advanced degree or MBA is a plus.

• 5–7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in Life Sciences, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or hardware-related industries.

• Strong leadership experience, including hiring, developing, and managing teams.

• Experience with lab informatics ecosystems (LIMS, ELN, integration standards such as SiLA2, OPC-UA, or similar).

• Deep technical understanding of APIs, distributed systems, middleware, orchestration, and embedded systems.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; German or other languages are a plus.

• Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution and a goal-oriented mindset.

• Experience with Agile methodologies and modern software development practices.

• Knowledge of regulatory and quality standards (e.g., ISO, FDA, GDPR).

• Willingness to travel internationally as required.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Product Development team and bring your passion and talent to work.

CAD / PDM Administrator (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

Are you passionate about making a difference in how teams work with cutting-edge CAD and PDM systems? At Tecan, you’ll play a key role in supporting innovation and efficiency across our global organization.

Responsibilities

• You’ll drive the development and improvement of our internal processes, tools, and best practices, collaborating with stakeholders from all Tecan sites.

• You’ll ensure our CAD and PDM systems are always available, up-to-date, and running smoothly, working closely with our IT department.

• You’ll support your colleagues by providing first-level support, sharing your expertise, and helping them get the most out of our systems.

• You’ll test new application versions, prepare and support upgrades, and collect user feedback to make our tools even better.

• You’ll create and update user documentation and training materials, and you’ll organize and lead engaging training sessions.

• You’ll act as a technical lead for CAD power users and as a local SAP Power User.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• You have a background in Mechanical Engineering

• You have more than 5 years of experience with PTC and Creo and brings experience in Windchill administration

• You have basic experience as an SAP user and have advanced IT knowledge in both hardware and software

• You’re familiar with scripting and basic programming

• You communicate fluently in both German and English, written and spoken

• You’re detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

• You enjoy working independently, are proactive, and can be relied upon by your team.

• You’re a great communicator, able to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.
